item.title: Sleep with Uncle Adenor Picking Up Leaves Under the Fig Tree | 1 Hour to Sleep
item.description:
Put on your headphones, close your eyes, and come sleep with Uncle Adenor tonight.

Uncle Adenor quietly gathers fallen leaves under the ancient fig tree, his slow movements a comforting presence in the cool, silent garden as night deepens.

Uncle Adenor slowly attends to the fallen leaves under his old fig tree in the quiet of the night. His movements are deliberate, a gentle rustle among the shadows. The cool, still air carries the faint scent of earth as he meticulously gathers each leaf, his presence a comforting, steady rhythm in the deep hours.

item.title: The silent music box that played again | Sleep Story
item.description:
A relaxing sleep story designed to help you unwind and fall asleep.

Tonight you'll hear "The silent music box that played again."

Let this story be a quiet refuge. In a room filled with the soft sound of rain, a dark wooden music box sits in the shadows, covered in a fine layer of dust. Its silence is ancient, holding the memory of a forgotten melody. Come closer and listen to the story held within the quiet house, a tale waiting to be heard once more.
